in_marathi.name: Isitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Isitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Isitha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Isana’ which means god and ‘Ishita’ which means worshipped or revered. The name Isitha is believed to be the name of the goddess of wisdom and knowledge. In Hindu mythology, she is depicted as the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom.
